# Patton Logistics Group to invest $11M to expand in Pulaski County

 Chris Graham 

 Published date: August 15, 2021 | 7:18 am Updated: May 15, 2025 | 7:10 pm 

(© vepar5 – stock.adobe.com)

The Patton Logistics Group will invest $11 million to expand its trucking, logistics, and warehousing operation in the New River Valley Commerce Park in Pulaski County.

The company will expand its newly-constructed 250,000-square-foot logistics center by an additional 150,000 square feet. This expansion will include a trucking operations and maintenance center that will provide the infrastructure to support a future investment in electric trucks.

Virginia successfully competed with Pennsylvania for the expansion project, which will create 63 new jobs.

“The Patton Logistics Group has become a significant employer in Pulaski County and the New River Valley since they came to Virginia two years ago,” Gov. # GLS Invests €21 Million in New PLAZA Logistics Centre, Expands Workforce to 100

Por Editor

08/09/2026

GLS on Tuesday inaugurated a new logistics center at the Zaragoza Logistics Platform (PLAZA), the result of a €21 million investment developed jointly with Montepino. The opening will allow the company to quadruple its processing capacity in Zaragoza and expand its workforce from about 60 employees to nearly 100.

The new facility can handle up to 16,000 parcels per hour, compared with the 4,000 processed by GLS’s previous center in Ciudad del Transporte. The move also increases available space and operational capacity: the new warehouse is twice the size of the former site and has three times as many loading and unloading bays.

One of the center’s key features is the automation of sorting processes, designed specifically to accommodate activity increases linked to e-commerce campaigns. The facility will serve both GLS’s network of partner agencies and companies that use its distribution services.

# Antrim and Newtownabbey council approves DHL plans for £15m distribution centre in just 16 weeks

By Valerie Martin

Published 24th Aug 2026, 17:21 BST

## A new £15m DHL facility to be built in Newtownabbey “underpins the borough’s reputation as a hub for distribution excellence”, the council’s Planning Committee chairperson has said.

The committee approved plans for the distribution centre for DHL in just over 16 weeks, well below the 30-week target.

The new distribution centre at Ballyearl Business Park will comprise a 9,340 sqm storage and distribution facility with ancillary services, office space, solar panels an external yard, including HGV and car parking, landscaping and infrastructure works.

Representing a total investment of £18 million in the local economy, the development will create 80 new full-time jobs, retain 200 existing full-time roles, and support a further 100 construction jobs during the build phase.

#### New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment’s Midwest warehouse capacity

 Posted in Kenosha County Economic Development 

A Delavan-based third-party logistics and fulfillment company has significantly expanded its Midwest warehouse capacity after moving into a new distribution facility in Kenosha.

G10 Fulfillment now occupies 315,000 square feet of a 600,000-square-foot building at 12345 38th St., just off Interstate 94. The move increases G10’s dock capacity to 65 doors from 30.

“The Midwest is probably the most important hub for us,” said co-founder and CEO Mark Becker, who was on hand Thursday for a ribbon-cutting at the facility. He pointed to the region’s freight infrastructure and its location along the trucking corridor between Chicago and Milwaukee.

Becker said the facility can handle nearly 7 acres of inventory under one roof. G10 shares the building with food manufacturer Eagle Foods.

G10 invested about $2 million in the Kenosha buildout, which Becker said covered racking, automation and staffing costs.

Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

results.title: MyFreightWorld Expands in West Palm Beach, Adding 41 Jobs
results.text:
MyFreightWorld Expands in West Palm Beach, Adding 41 Jobs

# National Logistics Company to Expand West Palm Beach Operations

August 26, 2026 – West Palm Beach, FL – The Business Development Board of the Palm Beaches today announced the expansion of MyFreightWorld, a national third-party logistics company in West Palm Beach. The company will add 41 new team members over the next few years at an average income of $94,000. MyFreightWorld will move from its current location at 400 Clematis Street, Suite 203, into a 7,296-square-foot suite at 2090 Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard in West Palm Beach. The larger space is designed to support the company’s rapid growth and increased shipment activity across Palm Beach County and the country where it currently manages 25,000 shipments annually.

As it grows its current workforce from 20 to a total of 61 employees, the new positions are primarily for Account Executives and Account Management. Palm Beach County residents can apply online.

About the Expansion:

- Jobs: 41 new jobs in West Palm Beach; 20 current employees
- Pay: $94,000 average income
- Types of new roles: Account Executives, Account Management
- Link to apply: https://www.myfreight

Hollingsworth Logistics to add 150 jobs with Schertz expansion

# Hollingsworth Logistics to add 150 jobs with Schertz expansion

Kelsey Brown

Mon, October 5, 2026 at 7:06 PM UTC

View larger image

A Michigan-based supply chain provider will consolidate its Schertz operations into a 340,090-square-foot facility at Park35. (Bibb T. Gault/Cavender & Hill Properties)

The city of Schertz is boosting its workforce through a long-term deal with a leading supply chain provider in the manufacturing and distribution industry.

Hollingsworth Logistics Group signed a seven-year lease to expand and consolidate its Schertz operations, which will retain the company's 224 employees and add another 150 to its payroll. The move is intended to help the Michigan-headquartered company scale its operations to meet the demand from its customers across the aerospace, automotive, government, industrial and retail sectors.

The expansion stems from an economic development performance agreement between the company and the Schertz Economic Development Corp. approved by the Schertz City Council.

## FedEx Shipping and Logistics Facility to Open in New Kent County

 Written on August 13, 2026 

 

A new shipping and logistics facility leased by FedEx will open at the exit 211 interchange along Interstate 64 in New Kent County, Virginia. The 300,000-square-foot facility will be located at the Forge Logistics Center, located along Emmaus Church Road, and will employ approximately 40 full-time and 300 part-time positions.

“On behalf of New Kent County, we are proud to welcome FedEx and its newest operation to our community.” said New Kent County Administrator Rodney A. Hathaway. “This investment represents another significant milestone in the County’s continued economic growth and demonstrates New Kent County’s strategic location, strong transportation infrastructure, and business friendly environment.”
